contexts.text: To Ephesus, etc. () = all states of the reception of the Lord and His Church.

To the Angel of the Ephesian Church write () = to those, and concerning those who primarily regard truths of doctrine and not goods of life. ( = all those in the Church who are in the Knowledges of truth and good, thus in the Knowledges of such things as are of Heaven and the Church, and still are not, or are not as yet, in a life according to them. AE 93. AE 95.)
Doctrine is treated of in the addresses to the Churches in Ephesus and Smyrna.
